    • setColumnGroupingAmount

      public void setColumnGroupingAmount(int commandsPerCol)
      Parameters:
      commandsPerCol - The amount of commands to group together for each column that gets printed to stdout

      (NOTE: Grouping is done on a per-column basis since this allows all command descriptions (i.e.: their screens) to be always left-aligned by default with respect to the column (due to the horizontal composition))
